scripts.android:doctor: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ah=$env:ANDROID_HOME; $asr=$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT; $sdk=$ah; if (-not $sdk) { $sdk=$asr }; if (-not $ah) { $ah='' }; if (-not $asr) { $asr='' }; Write-Host ('ANDROID_HOME=' + $ah); Write-Host ('ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=' + $asr); $localPath=''; if (Test-Path android/local.properties) { Write-Host 'android/local.properties found'; $lp=Get-Content android/local.properties; $lp | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ }; $line=$lp | Where-Object { $_ -match '^sdk\.dir=' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($line) { $localPath=($line -replace '^sdk\.dir=','') -replace '\\\\','\\' } } else { Write-Host 'android/local.properties missing' }; if (-not $sdk -and $localPath) { $sdk=$localPath }; if ($sdk -and (Test-Path (Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools'))) { Write-Host 'platform-tools OK' } else { Write-Host ('platform-tools missing or SDK unset (resolved sdk=' + $sdk + ')'); exit 1 }"
